subject: FW: CAIQ evidence request — runtime artifacts for pen test scope
messages:
From: Tina Marshall <tina.marshall@atlascorp.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Cc: security@atlascorp.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 17:10:00 +0000
Subject: CAIQ evidence request — runtime artifacts for pen test scope

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our pre-pen test intake we need a CAIQ-aligned evidence bundle focused on runtime controls (networking, ephemeral key management, logging/kafka traces, and container isolation). Our pentest team highlighted they may request live runtime artifacts for a sampling window (72 hours) and a set of red-team-friendly telemetry so they can validate detection and containment controls.

Can you provide:
- The CAIQ control IDs you map to runtime detection/response and key management (we need control crosswalk).
- A sample bundle of runtime logs (redacted) and an example kernel/host-level evidence extract we can hand to the pentest lead.
- Any known gaps where evidence will require remediation or masking.

Deadline: we need a provisional bundle by Mon 30 Nov EOD UTC to schedule the pentest next week.

Attachment: pentest-scope.pdf (high level)

Thanks,
Tina Marshall
Security Program Manager — AtlasCorp
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Tina Marshall <tina.marshall@atlascorp.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 17:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence request — runtime artifacts for pen test scope

Tina — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. We can deliver a provisional bundle on Mon 30 Nov but need to scope two things first:

1) Exact CAIQ version you want mapped (v4.0 vs v5.0 differences on detection controls).
2) Clarify whether the pentest team requires raw host-level artifacts (e.g., /var/log/journal, containerd runtime logs) or higher-level telemetry (Redwood tracing + audit logs). Host-level extracts may require approvals from infra and legal for redaction.

Proposed owners:
- CAIQ mapping & narrative: Kimberly Park (CC'd)
- Runtime log extraction & redaction: Priyom Das (CC'd)
- Evidence upload + link generation: me

I'll start a short control crosswalk and a sampling checklist this afternoon and share a Drive link. Priyom: can you confirm whether we can produce a 72-hour sample that excludes PII and secrets?

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence request — runtime artifacts for pen test scope

Irene / Tina — quick status and the proposed CAIQ crosswalk: 

CAIQ controls we plan to surface (provisional): CCM-DI-01 (Logging and Monitoring), CCM-KE-02 (Key Management), CCM-SM-03 (Segmentation & Isolation), CCM-IR-04 (Incident Response / Telemetry), CCM-CA-05 (Configuration & Baselines).

Planned artifacts in the provisional bundle:  
- redwood_runtime_traces_72h.jsonl (tracing spans + request hashes, redacted)
- audit_api_keys.csv (access events for key management flows, token ids hashed)
- network_flow_summary_72h.csv (internal service-to-service flows, ports obfuscated)
- containerd-process-list-snapshot.tar.gz (host-level process snapshots, PII scrubbed)
- evidence_readme.md (mapping: each artifact -> CAIQ control ID + owner + collection time window)

Gaps / notes: 
- We do not routinely collect raw kernel dmesg snapshots for hosted endpoints; if the pentest requests kernel-level logs we need infra signoff and a short change control (3–5 business days).
- Live HSM-backed key material cannot be exported; we will provide KMS/HSM access logs and attestation statements instead.

Priyom — can you create the redaction script and run a dry-run on a synthetic 72-hour window? If green, please upload the sample bundle to the shared drive and flag any items that require legal redaction.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Security Engineering — Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, Tina Marshall <tina.marshall@atlascorp.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence request — runtime artifacts for pen test scope (bundle uploaded)

Team — bundle uploaded to shared Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/AtlasCorp-CAIQ-evidence-index (short link). What I uploaded (provisional, redacted where required):
- runtime-logs-sample.tar.gz (contains redwood_runtime_traces_72h.jsonl, network_flow_summary_72h.csv)
- pentest-report-redacted.pdf (example previous pentest summary, redacted)
- evidence_readme.md (control mapping + collection timestamps)

Notes for AtlasCorp pentest team:
- We scrubbed IPs and hashed request IDs; full raw host logs require a legal-approved narrow scope.
- KMS/HSM artifacts are attestation records only (no keys).
- If you need kernel-level state, please confirm the exact command/output required and provide a signed data-handling addendum; we will schedule infra-assisted capture within 48–72 hours after approval.

Tina — I've flagged the items that may need additional redaction in the readme. If the provisional bundle meets the team's needs we can hand off the Drive link to the pentest lead now.

- Priyom
Senior SRE (forensics & telemetry)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: runtime-logs-sample.tar.gz, pentest-report-redacted.pdf
